scenario: [LCON.2.4.1] under a self-join, where a matcher walks one alpha memory twice and the beta memory holds every partial match. Five A facts in three insertion orders; `pair` fires once per (x, y) with x.id < y.id, so ten firings and ten P facts: 15 facts in every order. Insertion order reorders both memories, so a runtime whose join walk leaked its memory or bucket order into the match set would disagree between orders on the count. LCON.2.4.1 itself has one rule per A and no join.
rules_ds:
schema A scope logical:
    id: Int key

schema P scope logical:
    lo: Int key
    hi: Int key

rule pair:
    A x
    A y where x.id < y.id
->
    emit P logical lo: x.id hi: y.id
